# opnsense_nginx_security_header (Resource)

nginx security header sets (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ HTTP(S) ▸ Security Headers**, plugin `os-nginx`).

- `description` (String) This is only for your reference.

- `enable_csp` (Boolean) If checked, the Content Security Policy (CSP) header is enabled. A detailed configuration is still required via the other tabs of this sheet. Defaults to `false`.
- `referrer` (String) Same Origin: The header will be sent if you stay on the same server using the same protocol (no data leak) No Referrer When Downgrade: Prevents sending a referrer when switching from HTTPS to HTTP Origin, Strict-Origin: Always send the header but no path or query information. Strict Origin additionally suppressed the header on downgrades. (Strict) Origin When Cross Origin: Full Referrer on the same origin, and like (Strict) Origin when cross domain. Unsafe URL: Sends the full URL to all pages. One of `no-referrer`, `no-referrer-when-downgrade`, `same-origin`, `origin`, `strict-origin`, `strict-origin-when-cross-origin`, `origin-when-cross-origin`, `unsafe-url`. Defaults to ``.
- `strict_transport_security_include_subdomains` (Boolean) If checked, also subdomains are affected. Defaults to `true`.
- `strict_transport_security_preload` (Boolean) If checked, the preload directive is added. Google maintains an HSTS preload service. By following the guidelines and successfully submitting your domain, browsers will never connect to your domain using an insecure connection. While the service is hosted by Google, all browsers have stated an intent to use (or actually started using) the preload list. However, it is not part of the HSTS specification and should not be treated as official. Defaults to `false`.
- `strict_transport_security_time` (Number) A time in seconds in which the transport security (TLS) should be enforced. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `xssprotection` (String) Block: The browser should block the response Off: Allow Anything On: The Browser decides how to handle it. One of `1; mode=block`, `0`, `1`. Defaults to ``.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the nginx security header set.
